# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_PUT_ABOVE_20

**Filed:** 2026-09-11
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Adding a VIX filter to only take put options when the 5-day average VIX is above 20.0 will avoid losses on low VIX days (like 4/29 and 5/01) and preserve wins on high VIX days (like 5/04), thereby increasing edge_capture on J winner days. Avoiding call options on 5/07 (if VIX is low) will reduce unwanted wins on J loser days, further improving edge_capture per OP-16.

## Mechanism
For put options entries, require that the 5-day average VIX (ending previous day) is >= 20.0. For call options, no change (rely on existing logic). This filter is applied pre-entry in the decision path.

## Expected impact on OP-16 anchors

| J day | Current engine behavior | Proposed behavior | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4/29 winner | lost $23.95 | avoid trade (due to low VIX) -> $0 | +$23.95 |
| 5/01 winner | lost $21.56 | avoid trade (due to low VIX) -> $0 | +$21.56 |
| 5/04 winner | won $804.72 | win (VIX high) -> $804.72 | $0 |
| 5/05 loser | skipped -> $0 | skipped -> $0 | $0 |
| 5/06 loser | skipped -> $0 | skipped -> $0 | $0 |
| 5/07 loser 1 | won $74.29 (call) | avoid call trade? (if VIX low) -> $0 | +$74.29 (avoids subtracting winner on loser day) |
| 5/07 loser 2 | won $74.29 (call) | avoid call trade? (if VIX low) -> $0 | +$74.29 (avoids subtracting winner on loser day) |

(Note: Delta reflects improvement in edge_capture. For winner days, turning a loss to zero increases edge_capture. For loser days, avoiding a win means we subtract less in the OP-16 formula, increasing edge_capture.)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Based on single baseline run (empty combo) over ~1.5 years. J days sample: 6 days (3 winners, 3 losers). High overfit risk as proposal targets specific days (4/29, 5/01). Requires OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS test executed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills validation on J days for this candidate)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: skipping high VIX put winners (e.g., 5/04 if VIX miscalculated) -> lost opportunity.
   - Max drawdown: could increase if avoiding winning trades on high VIX days due to faulty VIX.
   - Blow-up: VIX filter failure during true high VIX event -> taking excessive losses on puts.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown without backtest. If effective, top-5 days may remain 5/04-dominated; estimate top-5 days >100% of P&L (needs verification).
